# ledger_api_tokens (Data Source)

Lists the API tokens of every user, in identifier order, expired and revoked ones included unless filtered. **Metadata only**: Ledger never serves a token's secret again, and these data sources have no secret attribute. Reading token metadata needs an API token with the `tokens:read` grant; revoking needs `tokens:write`. **Creating a token needs the root token of the root account** (the first user, normally created with `ledger token create --create administrator --root` on the Ledger host): Ledger refuses `POST /auth/tokens` for any other API token with 403 `forbidden`. Revoking a root token needs the root token too (`root_token_required`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Active tokens of one user, e.g. to audit what exists. Metadata only; needs the tokens:read grant.
data "ledger_users" "root" {
  roles = ["administrator"]
}

data "ledger_api_tokens" "active" {
  owner_id = data.ledger_users.root.items[0].id
  statuses = ["active"]
}

output "active_token_names" {
  value = [for t in data.ledger_api_tokens.active.items : t.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `owner_id` (String) Only this user's tokens.
- `statuses` (List of String) Only tokens with one of these statuses (`active`, `expired`, `revoked`); filtered here, not by Ledger.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `expires_at` (String) When it expires, or null when it never does.
- `grants` (Set of String) The token's own grants (empty for a root token). Requests get only those the owner's current role allows.
- `hint` (String) The prefix and the first and last characters, to recognise the token.
- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier.
- `last_chars` (String) The last four characters.
- `last_used_at` (String) When it was last used (at most once a minute), or null.
- `name` (String) The token's name.
- `owner_id` (String) The user that owns the token.
- `parent_token_id` (String) The token that created it through the API, or null.
- `prefix` (String) `ldgr_` and the first four random characters.
- `revoked_at` (String) When it was revoked, or null.
- `root` (Boolean) Whether it is a root token.
- `status` (String) `active`, `expired` or `revoked`.
